sourceRefs.locator: Section 1, モンゴル襲来と元寇防塁: the 1274 fighting at Torikai, written accounts of the fire at Hakozaki and the dating of heat-damaged pottery and burnt soil between the late thirteenth and early fourteenth centuries.
Opening discussion, pp. 54–57, on Takezaki Suenaga, his reward claim, the scrolls he commissioned and their later alteration.
SZK002942, description of the two scrolls, the 1274 and 1281 invasions and missing or rearranged portions.

labels.en: A fire recorded at Hakozaki shrine

note.de: Als Truppen aus dem Yuan-Reich und Goryeo in die Hakata-Bucht gelangen, berichten Quellen von einem Brand am Schrein. Die archäologische Brandschicht bei Hakozaki lässt sich weniger eng datieren.
note.en: Sources report a fire at the shrine when forces from the Yuan realm and Goryeo reach Hakata Bay. The burnt deposits excavated locally have a broader date range.
